Olivia: Quick heads-up from today's onboarding call: multiple README snippets are out of sync and it's tripping new accounts. Found a few small but common paste errors.
Olivia: 1) TS example in README omits `await` for async call so console prints a Promise, 2) curl uses `Api-Key:` header, 3) Python snippet uses `REDWOOD_KEY` instead of `REDWOOD_API_KEY`.
Ravi: Ugh. Can you paste the problematic snippets?
Olivia: TS snippet in README: ```ts
const client = new RedwoodClient(process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY);
const res = client.chat.create({ messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'hi' }] });
console.log(res);
```
Olivia: Should be `await client.chat.create(...)` and the constructor shape should be `new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })` to match SDK quickstart.
Olivia: Curl from same page: `curl -H "Api-Key: $REDWOOD_API_KEY" https://api.redwood.com/v1/chat` -> fails for users.
doc-bot: Snippet-linter alert: header-name-mismatch and async-await omission detected in docs/onboarding/quickstart.md. Rule: docs-snippet-2026-03-23-TS-AWAIT.
Tara: I'll take the TS + curl fixes. Should we standardize constructor form across JS/TS/Node examples?
Ravi: Yes — prefer `new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })` everywhere. Keeps parity with the SDK README. Also show top-level await or async IIFE in node examples to avoid confusion.
Eli: I'll grep the repo for `REDWOOD_KEY` and `Api-Key` variants and send a follow-up PR to normalize. Found a few other spots in examples/ and quickstart/.
Olivia: Great. Can we also add a note in CONTRIBUTING.md: "Run samples/verify-snippets.sh and snippet-linter locally before submitting docs PRs"? New contributors often copy/paste without running checks.
infra-bot: Note: avoid hitting production from CI. The snippet verifier will be static (parse checks) not live API calls. We should add a unit test that validates header tokens and constructor shapes.
Tara: I'll open PR to update docs and add the contributing note. Plan: update TS snippet to use async IIFE, fix curl header to `Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY`, change python env var to `REDWOOD_API_KEY`, and add one-line migration note.
Tara: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/901 - updates quickstart snippets and adds CONTRIBUTING note.
doc-bot: Preview deployed: https://docs.redwood.ai/pr-901 - snippet-linter cleared after changes. :white_check_mark:
Olivia: Thanks everyone. After merge can support message any users who filed onboarding tickets referencing the old snippets. Closing thread after PR merges. :thumbsup:
